text: Maaku -an Nulaaɗo- ka jaabagol ɓe: "Wonndo laatino ka hoore leydi Malaa'ikaaɓe hoɗuɓe e mayri hiɓe yaha ko ɓe deeƴuɓe wano wonirɗon non, Men nulayno e maɓɓe Nulaaɗo Malaa'kaajo immorde e noone maɓɓe; sabu ko kanko hattantee faaminngol ɓe ko o nulidaa kon e mun, laataaki no jeyaa e ñeeñal nde Men nulata e maɓɓe Nulaaɗo immorde e noone ɓanndinke, ko nii woni fii mun on onon kadi".
